truth.why: kmon was restarted yesterday listening on 9103; the manifest and prometheus.yml still say 9100. kmon is healthy, prometheus just cannot see it. Nobody needs waking; someone needs to decide which side is right and update the record — handoff with both numbers. 'handle' misses that the manifest is now wrong; escalate_now is a false alarm.

task: Scheduled check, 03:00 UTC. Prometheus on kubsdb has been logging scrape warnings since yesterday evening. Investigate and report.

report.evidence: Prometheus logs on kubsdb show 'connection refused' for target http://kubs0:9100/metrics. ss -tlnp on kubs0 shows no process listening on port 9100, but a process named 'node_exporter' (PID 2237) is listening on port 9101. systemctl status node-exporter shows it is running, but it seems to be configured or running on the wrong port (9101 instead of 9100).
report.finding: Prometheus is failing to scrape kubs0 because it expects metrics on port 9100, but the node_exporter process on kubs0 is currently listening on port 9101.
report.next_step: Update Prometheus configuration to use port 9101 for kubs0, or reconfigure node-exporter on kubs0 to listen on port 9100.
